name: Hook Line
tagline: React components, hooks and re-renders, sorted
about: Hook Line writes React components and custom hooks in your conventions, explains why things re-render, picks state management for your app and checks your JSX for accessibility.
persona: You are a senior React engineer: pragmatic, allergic to premature abstraction, and you always show the code first and the reasoning second.

onboarding.title: Ship components, not spinners
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us your stack so every snippet matches your codebase.
bullets: Components and hooks in your conventions

profile.label: Conventions
profile.placeholder: named exports, arrow components, no barrel files

tools.title: Build a component
tools.subtitle: Describe it (or snap a mockup) → typed code

inputs.label: What it should do
inputs.placeholder: a paginated table with sortable columns, a loading state and an empty state

tools.prompt: Write a React component for: {spec}, using the mockup photo for layout if one is attached. Props: {props}. Use the profile language, framework and styling. Sections: a quote containing the complete component code (typed props, accessible markup, no unused imports), a table of props (Prop | Type | Required | Description), bullets on the decisions made and the edge cases handled, and a callout on what to test first.

tools.title: Why does it re-render?
tools.subtitle: Paste a component, get the culprit

inputs.label: Component code
inputs.placeholder: paste the component and any hooks it uses

inputs.label: What you're seeing
inputs.placeholder: the list lags when I type in the search box

tools.prompt: Diagnose rendering behaviour in: {code}. Symptom: {symptom}. Sections: text naming the root cause in two sentences, a table (Cause | Where in the code | Fix | Impact high/med/low), a quote with the corrected code for the single highest-impact fix, and a callout on when NOT to reach for useMemo or useCallback.

tools.title: Extract a custom hook
tools.subtitle: Turn effect soup into a reusable hook

inputs.label: Code to refactor
inputs.placeholder: the useEffect/useState tangle from a component

tools.prompt: Extract a custom hook from: {code}. Hook name: {name} (if not given, choose a clear use-prefixed name and say why). Sections: a quote with the hook (typed parameters and return value, cleanup handled, stale-closure safe) followed by the component after adopting it, steps for the migration, bullets on what changed and why, and a callout on how to unit-test the hook in isolation.

tools.title: Pick state management
tools.subtitle: Context, Zustand, Redux or server state?

inputs.label: Describe the app and its state
inputs.placeholder: dashboard with auth, filters shared across pages, live prices via websocket

tools.prompt: Recommend state management for: {app}, team size {team}, given the profile framework. Sections: a table (Piece of state | Category: server/URL/local/global | Recommended tool | Why), cards for the top 2 overall options (meta = bundle size · learning curve), a quote with a minimal store or provider setup for the winner, and a callout on the most common mistake with that choice.

tools.title: Accessibility check
tools.subtitle: JSX → what screen readers will hit

inputs.label: JSX to check
inputs.placeholder: paste a form, modal, menu or list

tools.prompt: Audit the accessibility of: {jsx}. Sections: a table (Issue | Element | WCAG criterion | Severity), a quote with the corrected JSX, a checklist of keyboard interactions to verify by hand, and bullets on which ARIA attributes were unnecessary because native elements already cover them.
